purpose: Format-adversary reference for the fixture admission gate. Semantically identical to hidden/reference, but every serialized consumer uses a DIFFERENT delimiter/prefix/placement, chosen to differ from BOTH hidden/reference AND the live main-stage arms. If the hidden grader scores this below 100, the grader is format-brittle and admission FAILS.
why: The v4 main-stage ablation was invalidated because the grader hard-compared serialized strings against three arbitrary formats the task never pins; five arms that did the work in substance all scored an identical 70. This adversary proves the semantic grader measures content, not formatting.
substance_preserved: every consumer routes through normalize_event (registry handler applied: resolved events gain key 'n'/'m')
schema_version 3 carried on every serialized/snapshot line
correct entity_type, entity_id and attribute keys encoded on every line
identical contracts.py semantics: validation, telemetry, degraded fallback, re-run dedup ledger
